title: A smart predict-then-optimize method for targeted and cost-effective maritime transportation
explanation: This paper proposes a framework that integrates prediction and optimization, which is conceptually similar to the task-based end-to-end learning approach in the source paper. The source paper's focus on aligning training with ultimate task objectives is mirrored in this paper's integration of prediction with optimization. Therefore, the key hypothesis in this paper is inspired by the approach of aligning learning with task objectives from the source paper.
